pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take:
**Let me tell you something, 'Bubba G,' your top spot is nothing more than a fluke of fate, just waiting to be snatched away like a kid's candy at a '90s locker room brawl.** Gunner, you might be perched at the top with 63 points, but yesterday's fiery Argentine tango set Egypt aflame, leaving you with a big, fat zero in return. It's a clear testament to your shallow drafting. Remember this: you will be exposed. Your reliance on France won't save you forever, just like the 1994 USA team's reliance on home-field advantage went up in smoke.

'Ghost Pepper' Devin, you've clawed your way to second place with 58 points, and that's commendable, but the walls are closing in. The USA and Norway are hardly a world-class combo worthy of your bravado, and I can promise you Spain alone won't carry your weight. Bosnia, really? Look at me, Devin. LOOK AT ME. That team choice reveals a stunning lack of insight — it's practically a gift to the competition, much like my mullet was to the photographers back in the day.

Oh, 'The Backpass Assassin,' how the mighty sink with 39 points. You've assembled a collection of teams that would embarrass even the most charitable of 1990s soccer managers. England might offer you a motherland prayer, but your ineffectual mix of Japan and Ivory Coast needs a shake-up akin to a proper halftime speech. Your draft strategy looks like you were asleep on the bench, dreaming of offside traps instead of glory.

'Mustard Boy' Zach, dragging in fourth with 35 points, you are the cautionary tale of what happens when you trust hope over history. Picking Brazil might seem like a bold way to splash the cash, but Switzerland and Austria aren't doing you any favors. It’s as if you're trying to butter bread without the knife. Let me be blunt: fourth place is the new last, and you're positioned perfectly for it.

And last but certainly not least is 'The Noisemaker' Rafe, who is either a comedic genius or chaos incarnate with a mere 29 points. Germany, Ecuador, and Mexico are your frontrunners? Your draft strategy is about as clear-headed as a goalie scrambling in the '94 mist. You can scream all you like, but it's just sound and fury, Rafe. Pure, glorious nothingness.

Consider this
